workflow: read-only audit; no network calls; no repository writes

skill_table.skchr_oblvns_1.levels[9].name: 新月的苏醒
skill_table.skchr_oblvns_1.levels[9].description: 演奏出<@ba.vup>8</>个音符。每个音符造成的法术伤害依次从攻击力的<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>逐渐降低至<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_8:0%}</>。\n<@ba.rem>可充能2次，充能至最大层数时自动释放一次</>

skill_table.skchr_hsgma2_2.levels[9].name: 无始无明
skill_table.skchr_hsgma2_2.levels[9].description: 投出盾牌并以攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>的三连击攻击所有阻挡的敌人，盾牌会环绕斩业星熊飞行<@ba.vup>一圈</>；盾牌碰到敌人时使目标<$ba.sluggish>停顿</>，每{interval}秒对其造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{shield_atk_scale:0%}</>的法术伤害，自身回复盾牌造成伤害<@ba.vup>{heal_ratio:0%}</>的生命

skill_table.skchr_orchd2_1.levels[9].name: 刚射
skill_table.skchr_orchd2_1.levels[9].description: 发射4支攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_1:0%}</>的箭矢，若还有充能则额外消耗1层施展<@ba.vup>刚连射</>：发射5支攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_2:0%}</>的箭矢，每支箭矢有<@ba.vup>{stun_prob:0%}</>概率使目标<$ba.stun>晕眩</><@ba.vup>{stun}</>秒\n<@ba.rem>可充能4次，充能至最大层数时自动释放一次</>

skill_table.skchr_orchd2_2.levels[9].name: 飞翔瞪射
skill_table.skchr_orchd2_2.levels[9].description: 立刻<$ba.liftoff>起飞</>并对前方范围的所有目标射击3次，分别射出3、4、5支攻击力提升至<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_loop:0%}</>的箭矢；之后降落并对前方小范围内的所有敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_end:0%}</>的物理伤害\n<@ba.rem>可充能3次，部署后立即释放一次</>

skill_table.skchr_orchd2_3.levels[9].name: 龙之箭
skill_table.skchr_orchd2_3.levels[9].description: 蓄力<@ba.vup>3</>秒后射出直线飞行的贯穿箭矢，箭矢以<@ba.vup>较大力度</>推动每个经过的敌人，每飞行一段距离都会对周围所有敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害和攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_magic:0%}</>的法术伤害，箭矢射程无限\n<@ba.rem>可充能2次</>

interpretation_limits.instant_mode: May describe trigger classification; it does not prove actual duration=0 or simultaneous multihit clocks.
interpretation_limits.no_target_case: The label no_target means owner target_windows=[]; it does not prove an independently orbiting shield has no target.
interpretation_limits.shield_contact_ticks: A manual conditional contact count; cannot be silently canceled by owner supply windows or converted to scheduled ticks.
interpretation_limits.interrupt_case: Reproduction only; unknown cancel/persistence rules for emitted notes/arrows/shield.
interpretation_limits.liftoff_charge_parameters: Orchd2 S2/S3 blackboards do not bind actual phase times.
interpretation_limits.global_disappearance_at_zero: target_disappears_seconds=0 means current target lifetime is zero; damage and damage-dependent healing against that target are known zero, independently of owner supply-window semantics and in both timing modes.
